General Questions

The Bloom Forward is a faith-based non-profit organisation founded in 2015. We work across 18 countries to empower communities through education, food relief, healthcare, women's empowerment, youth development, and environmental sustainability.

Yes. Our work is motivated by Christian faith — specifically the biblical call to serve the poor and marginalised. However, we serve all people regardless of their faith, ethnicity, or background. We never attach religious conditions to our humanitarian services.

We currently operate in 18 countries across Sub-Saharan Africa, South Asia, and Latin America, with our headquarters in Accra, Ghana. Our flagship programmes run in Ghana, Kenya, Uganda, Senegal, Nigeria, and Ethiopia.

The Bloom Forward is governed by an independent Board of Trustees and is registered as a charitable organisation in Ghana, the UK, and the USA. Annual financial audits are conducted by an independent firm, and reports are publicly available.

Donations & Giving

You can donate online via our secure donation page using a credit card, PayPal, or bank transfer. We accept both one-time and monthly recurring donations. For major gifts or other giving methods, contact our team directly.

Yes, to the extent permitted by law in your country. Donations made through our UK entity qualify for Gift Aid, and US donors receive a receipt for IRS purposes. You will receive a donation acknowledgement by email after every gift.

Absolutely. On our donation page you can direct your gift to any of our six programmes — Education, Community Development, Women's Empowerment, Youth Development, Health & Wellness, or Environmental Sustainability — or to "Where Most Needed."

We maintain a programme delivery rate of 86% — meaning 86 cents of every dollar donated goes directly to programme delivery. The remaining 14% covers essential operational costs including governance, administration, and fundraising. Full accounts are published annually.

Volunteering

Visit our Get Involved page and complete the volunteer registration form. Our volunteer coordinator will contact you within 5 business days to discuss opportunities that match your skills, availability, and location.

Not at all. We have roles for everyone — from skilled professionals (doctors, teachers, engineers) to unskilled volunteers who simply want to help with feeding drives, packing, and community outreach. A willing heart is your most important qualification.

Yes. We welcome international volunteers for placements of two weeks or longer. We also have remote volunteering opportunities in areas such as communications, translation, web design, fundraising, and research. Contact us to learn more.

Our Programmes

Beneficiaries are identified through community-based assessments conducted in partnership with local leaders, churches, and NGOs. We prioritise the most vulnerable — households living below the poverty line, orphans, widows, and people with disabilities.

We use a combination of quantitative data (number of beneficiaries, programme enrolments, health outcomes) and qualitative assessments (interviews, case studies). Independent evaluations are conducted every two years and published in our Annual Impact Report.

Partnerships

We have a dedicated Church Partnership Programme that allows congregations to co-fund specific projects, mobilise volunteers, and receive regular updates on the communities they support. Contact our partnerships team at partners@thebloomforward.org.

Yes. We offer corporate sponsorship packages for individual projects ranging from building a school classroom to running a mobile health clinic. Sponsors receive co-branding opportunities, site visit invitations, and detailed impact reports. Visit our Get Involved page to learn more.
